@graph.d3f:definition: The product implements access controls via a policy or other feature with the intention to disable or restrict accesses (reads and/or writes) to assets in a system from untrusted agents. However, implemented access controls lack required granularity, which renders the control policy too broad because it allows accesses from unauthorized agents to the security-sensitive assets.
@graph.rdfs:label: Insufficient Granularity of Access Control
Insufficient Granularity of Address Regions Protected by Register Locks
